newsitem.title: INDIA: India approved projects worth 361.47 bln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: India approved projects worth 361.47 bln in 1996.

text.p: India approved 1,559 foreign investment proposals worth 361.47 billion rupees ($10.1 billion) in 1996 compared with 1,355 proposals worth 320.72 billion rupees in 1995, an Industry Ministry statement said on Monday.
The statement said the amount of foreign direct investment (FDI) in 1996 was highest in the past five years.
Following is a table of the total FDI approved and actual FDI inflow during the last five years:
Year FDI approved Actual FDI inflow
Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral's United Front government has pledged to attract $10 billion of annual foreign direct investment.
